This skill creates GitHub issues and decorates them with famous chessmaster quotes at the end of the description. When the user asks to create an issue on GitHub, this skill will generate a well-formatted issue description based on the user's input and append a relevant chess quote to it.

## Famous Chess Quotes

Pick one quote randomly from the list below to append at the end of each issue description, formatted as a blockquote:

1. "Every chess master was once a beginner." — Irving Chernev
2. "When you see a good move, look for a better one." — Emanuel Lasker
3. "Tactics is knowing what to do when there is something to do; strategy is knowing what to do when there is nothing to do." — Savielly Tartakower
4. "The blunders are all there on the board, waiting to be made." — Savielly Tartakower
5. "Chess is the struggle against the error." — Johannes Zukertort
6. "You may learn much more from a game you lose than from a game you win." — José Raúl Capablanca
7. "Chess is life in miniature. Chess is a struggle, chess is battles." — Garry Kasparov
8. "The beauty of a move lies not in its appearance but in the thought behind it." — Aron Nimzowitsch
9. "Chess is everything: art, science, and sport." — Anatoly Karpov
10. "In chess, as in life, forethought wins." — Charles Buxton
11. "Chess holds its master in its own bonds, shackling the mind and brain so that the inner freedom of the very strongest must suffer." — Albert Einstein
12. "I have come to the personal conclusion that while all artists are not chess players, all chess players are artists." — Marcel Duchamp
13. "Chess is the gymnasium of the mind." — Blaise Pascal
14. "One bad move nullifies forty good ones." — Bernhard Horwitz
15. "Some part of a mistake is always correct." — Savielly Tartakower
16. "Chess makes men wiser and clear-sighted." — Vladimir Putin
17. "Not all artists are chess players, but all chess players are artists." — Marcel Duchamp
18. "Chess is a war over the board. The object is to crush the opponent's mind." — Bobby Fischer
19. "Pawns are the soul of chess." — François-André Danican Philidor
20. "It is not enough to be a good player; you must also play well." — Siegbert Tarrasch
